name: Smart Diff groups Files changed by role and Original order returns GitHub's order
description: PR #482 → Files changed tab: the latest review's findings show as a role-group counter (Core has at least one flagged file), then Original order flattens the groups and is kept in ?order=. Runs last (lexical order): if flows 09/11 already ran (E2E_MOCK_LLM), their review — findings on src/middleware/ratelimit.ts — is the newest and Core shows '● 1'; otherwise the seeded review (findings on src/config.ts + src/api/users.ts) is still newest and Core shows '● 2'. The counter assertion accepts either so the flow doesn't depend on run order. The PR list defaults to 'Needs review', which flows 09/11 make it fail (PR now 'reviewed'), so this flow clicks 'All' first, like flows 10/11. Read-only for this flow (no model call of its own).

steps.label: tall viewport: the PR page scrolls inside <main>, which agent-browser's click does not scroll
PR list: show All (flows 09/11 may have left the PR 'reviewed', hidden by the default 'Needs review' filter)
